overview: Over the last 25 years at UAB, I have dedicated a significant effort toward project leadership and mentoring. I have served as the Ph.D. thesis mentor for 14 graduate students in my own laboratory and have served on 71 other graduate student Ph.D. thesis committees. I have been the K-award mentor of two fellows and have trained other hematology/oncology fellows (2) and postdocs (7), the vast majority of whom continue to work in science-related careers. I have also served as the Co-Director of the Experimental Therapeutics Program within the Comprehensive Cancer Center between 2005-2018, as Associate Director of the Immunology Graduate Program, and as project Leader for the Personalized Medicine signature initiative in acute myeloid leukemia. Collectively, these efforts highlight my sincere and longstanding commitment to mentoring the next generation of scientists and leadership efforts to advance discovery science at UAB.
